say:2:1510842001:1.text: That's the necklace Gorgonna gave him.
say:2:1510842001:1.source_cn: 这是露送给珀尔修斯的那条项链。

say:3:1510842002:0.text: I recognize it. <style="highlight">We saw it back at Perseus' home.</style>

choice_prompt:4:1510842002.text: I recognize it. <style="highlight">We saw it back at Perseus' home.</style>
choice_prompt:4:1510842002.source_cn: 眼熟，我们<style=highlight>在珀尔修斯家里见过</style>。

say:5:1510842003:1.text: "From now on, you won't be anyone's prey." Not even Nazrik's powers could pinpoint him.
say:5:1510842003:1.source_cn: “从此之后，你不会成为任何人的猎物。”所以即便那非的追...

say:6:1510842004:1.text: Hmph. Sarethiel's emissary wielding the Hunting Goddess' power?
say:6:1510842004:1.source_cn: 哼，神使能调用狩猎神的权能？

say:7:1510842005:1.text: If she truly loved him, and if my theory is right, this might all be part of a <style="highlight">once-in-a-lifetime opportunity</style>.
say:7:1510842005:1.source_cn: 如果露真的深爱着珀尔修斯，如果我的猜想没错……也许，这...

say:8:1510842006:1.text: I think what we're seeing... are Gorgonna's memories.
say:8:1510842006:1.source_cn: 我想，展现在我们面前的，就是露的记忆。

choice_prompt:9:1510842006.text: I think what we're seeing... are Gorgonna's memories.
choice_prompt:9:1510842006.source_cn: 我想，展现在我们面前的，就是露的记忆。

say:10:1510842007:1.text: And yet, here at the sacred shrine of the goddess, all we see are visions of her love story with Perseus. For Gorgonna, her emissary, to fall for someone from Halia—it would be a betrayal.
say:10:1510842007:1.source_cn: 这里是狩猎神的神殿，我们却一直看到珀尔修斯和露相恋的记...

say:11:1510842008:1.text: If you were the Hunting Goddess, would you allow the shrine to hold the memories of a traitor?
say:11:1510842008:1.source_cn: 摩根，如果你是狩猎神，你会让神殿里出现叛徒的记忆吗？

say:12:1510842009:0.text: Hard to say. What if I'd lost my mind?
say:12:1510842009:0.source_cn: 不好说，万一我的脑子进水了呢。

say:13:1510842010:1.text: From what we know of the goddess, that's not her style. Unless... she knows Gorgonna didn't betray her.
say:13:1510842010:1.source_cn: 以我们对狩猎神的了解，她不是这种性格。除非，她知道露没...

say:14:1510842011:1.text: Which makes another possibility all the more likely...
say:14:1510842011:1.source_cn: 所以，另外一种可能性变得愈加确凿了……

say:15:1510842012:1.text: <style="highlight">Gorgonna never died.</style> Her true identity... is the Hunting Goddess.

choice_prompt:16:1510842012.text: <style="highlight">Gorgonna never died.</style> Her true identity... is the Hunting Goddess.
choice_prompt:16:1510842012.source_cn: ——<style=highlight>露根本没有死。</style>她的真实身份，就是狩猎神。

say:17:1510842014:1.source_cn: 没有比这更合理的猜想了。

say:18:1510842015:1.text: It explains why her memories appear here, and why Perseus still lives, even after being taken by the goddess.
say:18:1510842015:1.source_cn: 这即能说明为什么神殿里会有那二人相恋的记忆，也能解释为...

say:19:1510842016:1.text: Because the Hunting Goddess loves him. She would never harm him.
say:19:1510842016:1.source_cn: 因为狩猎神爱他，根本不会伤害他。

say:20:1510842017:1.text: I don't understand. And I'm too lazy to try to understand.
say:20:1510842017:1.source_cn: 我不理解。也懒得尝试去理解。

say:21:1510842018:1.text: At least it means that seaweed-haired idiot's still alive, right?
say:21:1510842018:1.source_cn: 至少说明那个海藻头就在这里的某处，对吧？

say:22:1510842019:1.text: We haven't reached the end of the shrine yet. Let's keep searching for any scraps of evidence with this guess in mind.
say:22:1510842019:1.source_cn: 尚未抵达神殿尽头，我们应该还能得到一些线索。带着这个猜...

say:24:1510842013:1.text: Why are you acting so surprised? Judging from your face, you were thinking the same thing.
say:24:1510842013:1.source_cn: 你怎么比我先啊了一声？我看你刚才的表情，还以为你也是这...
say:24:1510842013:1.male: Why are you acting so surprised? Judging from your face, you were thinking the same thing.
say:24:1510842013:1.female: Why are you acting so surprised? Judging from your face, you were thinking the same thing.

choice:4:0:1.text: He's been treasuring it all this time.
choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 珀尔修斯确实在好好珍惜它
choice:4:0:1.male: He's been treasuring it all this time.
choice:4:0:1.female: He's been treasuring it all this time.

choice:4:1:2.text: It really does hold strange power.
choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 项链上的确有特殊的力量
choice:4:1:2.male: It really does hold strange power.
choice:4:1:2.female: It really does hold strange power.

choice:4:2:3.text: No wonder it's been hard tracking him.
choice:4:2:3.source_cn: 怪不得无法追踪珀尔修斯
choice:4:2:3.male: No wonder it's been hard tracking him.
choice:4:2:3.female: No wonder it's been hard tracking him.
